features.title: Runnable --check coverage across all 9 kit regen generators
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd kit regen --check runs a real freshness check for every umbrella generator — versions (versions.json digests vs recomputed set), build (dist fingerprint), learn (patterns.json vs derivePatterns), sync-knowledge (knowledge JSONL vs scanKnowledge) — and reports zero skipped.
features.evidence: re-verified under microkernel-polish: asdd kit regen --check: 9/9 generators, 0 skipped, exit 0 | registry+versions tests: 34+5 pass | asdd check: 0 FAIL

features.title: harness-telemetry executable shape check (D-7/D-11)
features.user_visible_behavior: checkExecutableShape validates per-contract export shape: spec-drift-adapter keeps {id, description, run} read-only; a harness-telemetry adapter must literal-export {id, description, emit} and may only append (no writeFileSync/mkdir/etc).
features.evidence: node --test registry.test.mjs: 34 pass — 5 new shape tests (telemetry accept, missing emit, mutating call, spec-drift append ban, unknown contract); adapter.schema documents both subtypes

features.evidence: node --test registry.test.mjs: 34 pass — contributes.phases fails closed /kit-internal/ pinned (Q-NEW-1); commands already pinned (Q-NEW-3); resolution recorded in design.md + session 005
